caption: The drawing displays six distinct clothing items arranged on a plain beige background. At the top left is a tan dress featuring blue decorative trim and an attached light blue cape with white edging. To its right, near the upper center, is a light beige bonnet adorned with a pink ribbon and a lace trim at the edge. In the center right is a purple dress with a dark gray, short-sleeved, fur-trimmed vest; the dress is decorated with black diamond and line patterns along the hem. In the middle left is a gray hat with a blue ribbon and a cluster of pink flowers. At the bottom left is a white cape with a tan hood and wide tan trim running along the edge. At the bottom right is a long white coat, decorated with blue plaid lines and blue accents on the cuffs; there are small black decorative elements on the coat and the accompanying muff.
title: Doll and Wardrobe
